name: Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA
summary: Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA engages in producing, marketing, and selling wines and spirits in France, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and the Asia Pacific. The company provides scotch whisky, polish vodka, liqueurs and syrups, cognac, and tequila. It sells its products under the William Peel, Sobieski, Marie Brizard, Cognac Gautier, and San José brands, as well as various local brands. Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA was founded in 1755 and is based in Charenton-le-Pont, France. Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA operates as a subsidiary of Compagnie Financiere Europeenne De Prises De Participation SA.
